evidence_scope.exact_linear: Exact checks on finite matrices; universal basis/span theorem is separately proved by hand.
evidence_scope.pointwise_bounded: A posteriori absolute bounds for specified stored inputs/endpoints only; never commit permission.
evidence_scope.counterexamples: Explicit refutations of overbroad implications under specified arithmetic graphs.
evidence_scope.bitwise_certificates: Complete finite registered models; all-finite-time program consequence needs the separate closure/induction proof.
evidence_scope.BF16: Software RNE; no native BF16 certification.
evidence_scope.FP32: Local CPU scalar operations audited by exact rational RNE; no universal backend certificate.
evidence_scope.excluded: GPU, general concurrency, arbitrary compiler optimizations, full proof-assistant verification, general P2-C composition.
